family: Family sessions run every day, using two-seater, 200cc and 270cc karts.
Children aged 3 to 10 can ride as passengers in a two-seater kart with an adult.
Juniors aged 8 to 13 drive their own 200cc kart.
A kart with steering-wheel hand controls is available for people with reduced mobility.
A karting academy for ages 7 to 13 runs on Wednesday afternoons and Sunday mornings.
group: Groups can book Grand Prix races, challenges and private sessions; online booking is for groups of 8 or more.
Birthday parties are offered for ages 8 to 16.
Company team building, seminars and after-work events are offered, as are stag/hen parties and school outings (Tuesday to Friday, by reservation).
note: Opening hours are loaded dynamically and could not be read; phone 024 459 19 22. Kart brands are not named, except a Sodikart LR6 200cc 6hp used in the academy. Two-stroke karts are not allowed; owners of four-stroke karts are asked to call.

family: Children may drive the kids' rental karts from age 8 and 1.40 m tall, and both conditions must be met.
Kids' karts share the track with the adult rental karts, and the site suggests mornings for parents with concerns.
Under-16s must show parental permission or come with an accompanying adult.
Rotax Micro training for children's race karts is allowed from age 6.
group: Bookings for parties, company outings and corporate events are made by phone.
Fun races and Turbo-Kart races are held; the track is closed to rental driving from 10:00 to 14:30 on Turbo-Kart race days.
hours: Rental karts usually Mon-Thu 9:00-19:00, Sun 10:00-19:00; the schedule is published weekly and the track can be closed for championship days (e.g. Fri-Sat 9-10 Oct 2026, no rental).
note: The Turbo-Kart has a minimum age of 16, is for experienced drivers only and runs only on a dry track. Hours are published week by week, so Saturday rental hours were not visible this week.

family: Family sessions with controlled speed are for children, families and beginners, from 1.30 m tall.
On Wednesdays there is a family discount of three rides for the price of two.
Helmets, sturdy shoes and suitable clothing are required.
group: Group events start at 8 people and can be booked up to 3 days ahead, with Grand Prix and stag/hen party packages.
A 2-hour team race and exclusive hire of the whole track are available from 20 people.
Children's birthday parties are for 6 to 10 children (from 1.30 m), with an 8-minute training run and an 8-minute final.
note: The fleet is 24 Tomkart Swiss E-Karts. The outdoor track opens in good weather; opening hours were not shown in the fetched page text.
